sources.snippet: August 6, 2025 Accenture Invests in Snorkel AI to Help Financial Services Firms Transform Data into AI Solutions NEW YORK; Aug. 6, 2025 - Accenture (NYSE: ACN) has made a strategic investment, through Accenture Ventures, in Snorkel AI to help enterprises build and scale AI solutions more quickly by curating high-quality datasets for training and evaluating AI models.
